objective.statement: Measure and maximize risk-adjusted net return for a same-chain 2-4 hop atomic cycle while preserving state identity, authorization, settlement truth, and a complete opportunity denominator.

principal.reason: Phase 0 is read-only and no live principal is authorized.

gas.reason: Phase 0 cannot broadcast and must not invent a live gas-loss budget.

risk_budget.structural_bound: No wallet, signer, raw transaction, broadcast, deployment, or residual position capability exists in Phase 0.

success_semantics.shadow_candidate: Every hop and gas conversion share one state commitment and net profit remains above the proposed floor after all modeled costs.
success_semantics.live_success: Not available in Phase 0; a future EffectRecord must prove canonical receipt success, positive attributable settlement-asset delta, and FLAT residual exposure.
success_semantics.unknown: Any missing state, quote, coverage, receipt, balance, cost, or causal attribution remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

opportunity.definition: A revisioned immutable state snapshot proving a 2-4 hop route from one settlement asset back to itself with positive modeled net profit; events and websites only wake evaluation.
opportunity.revision_policy: A new block, flashblock sequence, pool state commitment, amount, route, or risk policy creates a new Opportunity and never mutates the prior action chain.
opportunity.atomicity: One same-chain transaction must begin and end in the same settlement asset and may not reuse one mutable liquidity source.

timing.clock: chain block or pending sequence plus monotonic local timestamps

activation.absolute_value: all required pool states, gas conversion, route identity, and policy commitment are known
activation.behavior: Phase 0 may evaluate and record shadow results only; it cannot prepare a signable transaction or broadcast before or after activation.

constraints.absolute_value: every hop and gas quote retains the exact same state commitment
the block remains canonical and has not been replaced

constraints.origin: frozen flashblock sequence when pending state is used
constraints.absolute_value: no later sequence supersedes the dependency commitment

timing.deadline_behavior: Stop evaluating the old action chain, mark the reason, and create a new opportunity revision only from a newly frozen state; continue evidence reconciliation.

profile.route_scope: 2-4 hop typed and allowlisted AMM adapters

correctness_invariants.condition: Every hop quote and gas conversion has the exact chain, state basis, reference, and commitment frozen by the Opportunity.
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: Prevents fictitious profit assembled from different market states.
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: One potentially valid candidate is omitted until a consistent snapshot exists.

latency_estimate.basis: Phase 0 performs an in-memory equality check.

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: Eliminates mixed-state false positives from the eligible set.

correctness_invariants.fallback: record BLOCKED_CORRECTNESS and wait for a new state revision

correctness_invariants.condition: The path is same-chain, contains 2-4 contiguous swaps, starts and ends in the declared settlement asset, and never reuses mutable liquidity.
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: Prevents hidden inventory, cross-chain finality risk, and double-counted pool liquidity.
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: Unsupported longer or non-atomic paths remain research-only.

latency_estimate.basis: Phase 0 validates route structure in memory.

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: Keeps the modeled payoff inside one atomic settlement boundary.

correctness_invariants.condition: Discovery source, launch platform, launch protocol, and liquidity venue are stored as independent evidence-backed claims.
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: Prevents a discovery API such as PAIR from being misreported as the platform or venue for unrelated assets such as NINECAT.
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: Unattributed pools remain UNKNOWN until chain evidence is available.

latency_estimate.basis: Phase 0 validates the normalized object locally.

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: Prevents wrong protocol adapters and product labels.

correctness_invariants.condition: live_execution_authorized is false and sign, broadcast, and calldata capabilities remain UNSUPPORTED.
correctness_invariants.risk_reduced: Prevents the research foundation from moving funds.
correctness_invariants.false_block_cost: No Phase 0 transaction can be attempted.

latency_estimate.basis: Static capability and runtime RPC allowlist checks.

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: Eliminates Phase 0 principal and gas loss from transaction submission.

adaptive_gates.condition: Pool fees, protocol costs, gas conversion, financing fees when applicable, and risk buffer are known at the same state.
adaptive_gates.risk_reduced: Prevents gross spread from being mislabeled as net profit.
adaptive_gates.false_block_cost: A real opportunity may remain unranked while a cost adapter is unavailable.

latency_estimate.reason: Live protocol adapters and latency distributions are not implemented.

voi_estimate.reason: Avoided false-positive and missed-edge distributions require Phase 1 evidence.

adaptive_gates.fallback: record the candidate as research-only and exclude it from eligible shadow profit

adaptive_gates.condition: The chainwide census watermark is gap-free through the required confirmed block or pending sequence.
adaptive_gates.risk_reduced: Prevents opportunity-frequency claims from an unknown denominator.
adaptive_gates.false_block_cost: Business-rate conclusions wait for backfill while individual candidates may still be evaluated.

latency_estimate.reason: Backfill and reorg performance are Phase 1 measurements.

voi_estimate.expected_loss_reduction: Stops incomplete scans from justifying infrastructure or capital expansion.

adaptive_gates.fallback: publish coverage as partial and suppress opportunity-rate conclusions

soft_checks.condition: Third-party indexers or platform APIs corroborate a chain-derived pool without delaying local evaluation.
soft_checks.risk_reduced: Improves metadata and operator discovery context.
soft_checks.false_block_cost: None because corroboration is not an execution gate.

latency_estimate.reason: External API latency is not measured.

voi_estimate.reason: No causal execution value has been established.

authorization.scope_binding: A future approval must bind chain, signer, settlement asset, typed route set, principal, gas-loss budget, profit floor, expiry, and immutable plan hash.
authorization.expiry_policy: The earliest of manual arm expiry and the composite opportunity boundary.
authorization.evidence_record: Append-only AuthorizationRecord in a future separately reviewed execution module.

execution.rpc_policy: Only explicitly allowlisted read methods are available.

recovery.phase0: No transaction can exist; malformed state or RPC failures produce BLOCKED_CORRECTNESS, BLOCKED_RESOURCE, or UNKNOWN evidence.
recovery.future_receipt_timeout: UNKNOWN until multi-source canonical reconciliation converges.
recovery.restart_policy: Resume from append-only evidence and coverage watermarks; never assume skipped blocks are empty.

exit.future_atomic_success: FLAT in the settlement asset; no ExitPlan.
exit.future_residual: Any nonzero or unknown residual creates an OPEN or UNKNOWN Position and blocks that wallet lane.

limitations: HTTP read allowlist and registry smoke CLI only; no production redundancy or WebSocket adapter.
Contract registries exist, but gap-free factory and PoolManager backfills are not implemented.
Source dimensions and registry invariants have unit tests; full live pool attribution is not implemented.
Cycle evaluation and v2 math use fixtures; no live v2/v3/v4/Aerodrome quote adapter exists.
No fork, trace, Hook, or token-semantics simulation adapter exists.
Phase 0 cannot produce signable transaction payloads.
No wallet, private key, account request, or signer dependency is present.
eth_sendRawTransaction and all non-read RPC methods are rejected before transport.
Coverage watermark exists; receipt, nonce, balance, and EffectRecord reconciliation do not.
Phase 0 cannot create a position, so no live exit capability is authorized.
Deterministic synthetic graph and quote fixtures only; historical chain replay is planned.

race_thesis.reward_source: Transient disagreement between executable AMM paths; the first state-changing capture is economically funded by the pre-existing pool imbalance after LP fees, protocol costs, gas, and financing.

sequencing_rule.reason: Phase 0 has not measured sequencer ordering, competitor submission paths, or same-opportunity winners on Base and Robinhood Chain. Phase 1 will discriminate with canonical block position and causal state changes.

race_thesis.earliest_public_signal: A canonical or pending pool-state change, liquidity change, or new pool event observable from a chain endpoint.
race_thesis.earliest_inferable_signal: A locally maintained dependency graph predicts that one changed pool may create a cycle before full-graph scanning.
race_thesis.earliest_safe_action: A typed route has exact same-state quotes, complete cost conversion, an immutable identity, and an atomic on-chain profit floor; Phase 0 still records only shadow evidence.
invalidating_evidence: Canonical same-state replay shows no positive net cycle after all costs.
A competitor consistently captures the exact opportunity before the proposed path can safely submit.
Observed Hook or token semantics break atomic settlement or exact quote assumptions.
Opportunity capacity is below the minimum size required to pay gas.

ladder.source: Factory, PoolManager, pool, and canonical block events with a local dependency graph.
ladder.causal_claim: A changed dependency can alter one or more atomic cycle outputs; the event itself does not prove profit.

ladder.source: Base Flashblocks pending state and pending logs.
ladder.causal_claim: A newer sequencer state can reveal a transient cycle earlier than a finalized block, subject to sequence replacement and coverage proof.

ladder.source: PAIR, Long, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, or an aggregator response.
ladder.causal_claim: The source can prioritize a cold-path lookup but cannot establish platform identity, completeness, or executable profit.

signal_strategy.false_positive_policy: A signal only creates an Opportunity candidate; mixed state, missing costs, unsafe semantics, or non-positive net value fail closed without a shot.
signal_strategy.false_negative_audit: Compare the gap-free chainwide census with observed candidates and later canonical profitable state changes; classify NOT_OBSERVED separately.

competition.competitor_model: UNKNOWN-v0: competitors may use private endpoints, colocated infrastructure, custom simulators, priority fees, or pre-positioned inventory; no global win-rate assumption is allowed.
ordering_evidence: UNKNOWN record plus future canonical block and transaction positions for the exact opportunity identity.

sample_policy.insufficient_behavior: Report exact counts and an interval; do not claim a stable win probability or authorize profit-mode execution.

profiles.reason: Discovery, live quotes, ordering evidence, signer, broadcast, reconcile, and execution contracts are not complete.

race_experiment.reason: No live transaction is required to validate Phase 0 correctness.

opportunity_census.source: Gap-free canonical Factory, PoolManager, and pool-state history, with Base pending sequences maintained as a separate non-final view.
opportunity_census.completeness_watermark: Per source: required_from, observed_through, canonical_head, confirmation_depth, explicit gaps, reorg corrections, and latest pending sequence.
opportunity_census.counterfactual_policy: Replay each chainwide candidate with the adapter and policy version valid at that state; never use a later price or gas value without labeling the counterfactual.

learning.model_versioning: Append-only adapter, cost, policy, competitor, and opportunity-identity versions; corrections supersede but never delete prior evidence.
